items.text:
I want to recommend it, but I can't.

The game is simply unfinished, it is an insult to a proper 1.0 version.

Tons of desperately needed QoL is simply non-existent which makes the gameplay often a chore or mess.

Mechanics aren't properly thought out. Especially the fire hazard at the starting stage is just... a mess still.

The simulation speed will crawl to a halt if you got any larger-scale ship going with multiple work orders.

Your character stops doing tasks as the most fundamental systems like the priority queue are badly designed.

The NPC interactions are extremely barebones, barely anything matters, despite it being such a massive complex system... it has basically zero effect for anything.

Everything is completely 'detached' from each other. Outside of curiosity there is plainly spoken no reason to ever leave the starting area and you don't even get any nudge gameplay wise to follow storylines, they just 'happen' at best or are missed entirely.

For a sandbox on the other hand it is vastly too limited. Making stations is nearly untenable, having NPCs deal with their own needs leads to dead NPCs, all the automated things one would expect for a crew to actually manage? They don't do properly, while regularly getting stuck in endless loops leading to their death for one reason or another.

No, absolutely don't buy, while the game idea is FANTASTIC, and it having all the necessary core aspects to make it a great game or even a masterpiece... it is all unfinished, making it solely 'sub-par'.
items.text_zh:
我想推荐它，但我不能。

这游戏就是没做完，这是对一个正经1.0版本的侮辱。

大量急需的生活质量改进根本就不存在，这让玩法常常变成苦差事或一团糟。

机制没有经过妥善思考。尤其是起始阶段的火灾隐患，还是……一团糟。

如果你让任何较大规模的飞船带着多个工作订单运转，模拟速度就会慢到停滞。

由于像优先级队列这样最基本的系统设计得很糟糕，你的角色会停止执行任务。

NPC互动极其简陋，几乎什么都不重要，尽管它是一个如此庞大复杂的系统……它对任何事情基本上都零影响。

一切都完全彼此‘脱节’。除了好奇心之外，直白地说，根本没有理由离开起始区域，而且你在玩法上也得不到任何推动去追随剧情线，它们充其量只是‘发生’，要么就完全被错过。

另一方面，作为一个沙盒，它又太过局限。建造空间站几乎难以为继，让NPC处理自己的需求会导致NPC死亡，人们期望船员能够妥善管理的所有自动化事项呢？他们做不好，同时还经常陷入无尽循环，因这样或那样的原因导致死亡。

不，绝对不要买，虽然这游戏的点子棒极了，而且它具备所有必要的核心要素，足以让它成为一款伟大的游戏甚至杰作……但这一切都没做完，使它仅仅只是‘平庸’。

items.text:
Really big shame, I was super excited for this game to be finished but their final release state is just ridiculous. To give the clearest summary possible, typing 'version 1.0' does not actually mean a thing is now 1.0. The game isn't finished, and it almost explicitely tells you that it isn't finished. Most of the map is still placeholder stations, the only fully fleshed out and finished areas seem to be OKLG, Venus, and MAYBE Ceres. If you dock at a station and the text pop-up ends with 'maybe someday pilots will be able to do more than trading,' that is the game telling you 'this is not a finished area.' My question is, if more than half the stations aren't finished, how is this a 1.0 release? How do you go from version 0.15 to 1.0 when you have so much more work to do? Imo, just call 0.15 a 1.0 version and remove the 'early access' tag.

The AI is still bad, they will choke themselves to death in space suits, if they are auto-tasked to haul stuff when their hands are full they will walk to the item and then cancel the task (because they don't know to put down what's in their hand/s,) there's no category for zones separating parts and whole ship pieces ('I want to put electronic parts like motherboards and scrap here, but I have to pick a category that will also cause the crew to haul whole computers and batteries that I don't need.) 

Relating to the above, the person-to-person combat and station security desperately needed more done to it. You can kill an entire station by venting the walls and then just fly off. If security dock with your ship to fine or arrest you 99% of the time you can win the fist fight with them and act like nothing happened. I guess something that would've fixed this is giving the security forces' ships some kind of weaponry, but frankly what REALLY needs to happen is adding more to the personnel combat so there's more challenge to different fights. Security forces having a partner, or adding in armour items, or adding more combat moves, etc. Piracy, or the piracy I've seen, has been some loser on a derelict with brass knuckles popping out and saying 'cough up the goods' before they're ventilated with a pistol. Like, lol, what? I haven't once had difficulty with personnel combat in the game thusfar. Even if there's more to it later on, I do not believe 65 hours is not long enough to see things pick up.
Update: In an area with more pirates, and found an AI issue with the personnel combat. The enemy AI seems to be unaware when they have firearms and will not engage in combat at all. I took out three pirates armed with pistols because instead of fighting back, they repeatedly demanded I surrender while being shot repeatedly. They didn't even try to use melee when I was standing directly infront of them for roughly five minutes. Hostile boarders also don't seem to understand that they're hostile boarders and won't go into my ship to attack me, they just stay in their ship. Also, anyone who isn't hostile who tries to dock with your ship (like if you make an SOS out of fuel call, or when NASS patrols dock for an inspection/issue fines,) they come in too hot, smash the ships together, and end up killing themselves.

Optimization is bad, randomly, for reasons I am completely lost on. The game will enter into a massive slowdown, or refuse to save, or freeze, or take forever to save. When you're on max speed torch driving on a 4 day trip, if you enter these slowdowns the AI can also freeze and cancel their own auto-orders. 

The gameplay loop is fun, but poorly implimented. The game effectively says you're a salvager, this is technically true and technically false. You START as a salvager, but this stops being worth it as you get later into the game. At bare minimum you need to be a space trucker once you get a torch drive, the time investment vs profit of salvage compared to cargo incentivizes cargo. Bounty hunting is in the game, but to do it you need to buy weapons, which are only sold at some stations (which are still placeholders,) and they are far enough away that you won't be able to get there for literal days of playing the game. After 65 hours, I haven't been able to get into ship combat at all. It's an extremely weird thing, when there ARE many systems in the game, but you won't be able to see them for days of irl time and need to go to unfinished parts of the game to get what you need to engage with it.

Personal gripe this time, but I really wish there was more horror/supernatural/strange elements. Someone could argue they're there, but rare, but I'd disagree. There is one major event early on, and once its solved you won't see anything. Atleast, I haven't seen anything else.

I haven't finished the main storyline, but I still have criticisms here regardless. Without spoilers, there has been very little story crossover with the game mechanics. Only the meat storyline affects the game that I've seen. To emphasize, I've played 95 hours total, 65.8 since release, and one storyline actually introduced something that affected how I play. I understand Neo Scavenger also used text screens for its story, but this game isn't played the same way. Combat is not done through text screens, exploration is not done through text screens, conversations are not done through text screens, it's done in a pausible realtime. Maybe there's something that happens later, I've read a dev message that it does, but if you're only seeing something once 65.8 hours in then I'd dare say there is not enough stuff in here. 

Anyway blah blah ramble ramble the game just isn't finished. You can still have fun with it but you should consider that before deciding whether or not to buy it. It came out of early access from a 0.15 (or 0.17? can't remember) version and it shows.
items.text_zh:
真是巨大的遗憾，我超级期待这款游戏完成，但他们的最终发布状态简直荒谬。尽可能给出最清晰的总结：输入“1.0版本”实际上并不意味着某个东西现在是1.0。游戏没有完成，而且它几乎明确地告诉你它没有完成。大部分地图仍然是占位空间站，唯一完全充实和完成的区域似乎是OKLG、金星，也许还有谷神星。如果你停靠在一个空间站，弹出的文本以“也许有一天飞行员能够做的不仅仅是贸易”结尾，那就是游戏在告诉你“这不是一个完成的区域”。我的问题是，如果超过一半的空间站没有完成，这怎么算1.0发布？当你还有那么多工作要做时，你怎么从0.15版本跳到1.0？依我看，干脆把0.15称为1.0版本，然后去掉“抢先体验”标签。

AI仍然很糟糕，他们会穿着宇航服把自己呛死，如果他们手满时被自动分配去搬运东西，他们会走到物品那里然后取消任务（因为他们不知道放下手里的东西），没有区域分类来区分零件和整艘飞船部件（“我想把主板和废料这样的电子零件放在这里，但我必须选择一个类别，这也会导致船员搬运我不需要的整台电脑和电池。”）

与上述相关，人与人之间的战斗和空间站安保迫切需要更多完善。你可以通过给墙壁放气杀死整个空间站，然后直接飞走。如果安保停靠你的飞船来罚款或逮捕你，99%的情况下你可以赢得与他们的拳斗，然后装作什么都没发生。我想能解决这个问题的是给安保部队的飞船配备某种武器，但坦率地说，真正需要发生的是增加更多人员战斗内容，让不同战斗更有挑战性。安保部队有搭档，或者加入护甲物品，或者增加更多战斗动作等等。海盗行为，或者我见过的海盗行为，就是某个废物在废弃飞船上戴着黄铜指虎跳出来说“交出货物”，然后被手枪打得透不过气。就像，哈哈，什么？到目前为止，我在游戏中一次都没有在人员战斗中遇到困难。即使后面还有更多内容，我也不相信65小时还不够看到事情起色。
更新：在一个海盗更多的区域，发现了人员战斗的AI问题。敌方AI似乎不知道他们有枪械，完全不会交战。我干掉了三个持手枪的海盗，因为他们没有反击，而是一再要求我投降，同时被反复射击。当我直接站在他们面前大约五分钟时，他们甚至没有尝试使用近战。敌对登船者似乎也不明白他们是敌对登船者，不会进入我的飞船攻击我，他们只是待在自己的飞船里。另外，任何非敌对的人试图停靠你的飞船（比如你发出燃料求救信号，或者NASS巡逻队停靠进行检查/开罚单），他们进来时太猛，把飞船撞在一起，最终杀死自己。

优化很差，随机地，原因我完全不明白。游戏会进入大规模减速，或者拒绝保存，或者冻结，或者保存要花很长时间。当你在4天旅程中以最大速度火炬驱动时，如果你进入这些减速，AI也可能冻结并取消他们自己的自动命令。

游戏循环很有趣，但实现得很差。游戏实际上说你是打捞者，这在技术上是对的，也在技术上是错的。你开始时是打捞者，但随着游戏后期进展，这不再值得。至少一旦你获得火炬驱动，你需要成为太空卡车司机，打捞与货物相比的时间投入与利润激励了货物。赏金猎人在游戏中，但要做它你需要购买武器，这些武器只在某些空间站出售（这些仍然是占位符），而且它们足够远，你实际上玩几天游戏都到不了那里。65小时后，我完全没能进入飞船战斗。这是一件极其奇怪的事情，当游戏中有许多系统时，但你现实时间几天都看不到它们，并且需要去游戏未完成的部分获取参与所需的东西。

这次是个人抱怨，但我真的希望有更多恐怖/超自然/奇怪元素。有人可能会说它们存在，但很罕见，但我不同意。早期有一个重大事件，一旦解决你就不会再看到任何东西。至少，我没有看到其他任何东西。

我还没有完成主线剧情，但无论如何我在这里仍有批评。没有剧透，故事与游戏机制的交叉非常少。我只看到肉类 storyline 影响游戏。强调一下，我总共玩了95小时，发布后65.8小时，只有一个 storyline 实际引入了影响我游玩方式的东西。我理解Neo Scavenger也用文本屏幕讲故事，但这款游戏的玩法不同。战斗不是通过文本屏幕完成的，探索不是通过文本屏幕完成的，对话不是通过文本屏幕完成的，它是在可暂停的实时中完成的。也许后面会发生什么，我读过开发者消息说会，但如果你在65.8小时后才只看到一次东西，那我敢说这里内容不够。

总之 blah blah 胡扯胡扯，游戏就是没完成。你仍然可以玩得开心，但在决定是否购买之前应该考虑这一点。它从0.15（还是0.17？记不清了）版本脱离抢先体验，而且这很明显。
自动指令。

游戏循环很有趣，但实现得很糟糕。游戏实际上说你是打捞者，这在技术上既对也不对。你一开始是打捞者，但随着游戏进程推进，这就不再值得了。至少在你获得火炬驱动器后，你需要成为一名太空卡车司机，打捞与货物相比，时间投入与利润的对比会促使你选择货物。赏金猎人在游戏中存在，但要进行赏金猎人活动，你需要购买武器，而武器只在某些空间站出售（这些空间站仍然是占位符），而且它们距离足够远，以至于你在实际游玩中好几天都到不了那里。玩了65小时后，我完全没能进入飞船战斗。这非常奇怪，因为游戏里确实有很多星系，但你在现实时间的好几天内都看不到它们，而且你需要前往游戏未完成的部分才能获得参与其中所需的东西。

这次是个人抱怨，但我真的希望有更多恐怖/超自然/奇异元素。有人可能会说它们存在，但很罕见，但我不同意。早期有一个重大事件，一旦解决，你就不会再看到任何东西了。至少，我没看到其他任何东西。

我还没有完成主线剧情，但无论如何我在这里仍有批评。不剧透地说，剧情与游戏机制的交叉非常少。据我所见，只有肉类剧情线影响了游戏。强调一下，我总共玩了95小时，自发布以来玩了65.8小时，而只有一条剧情线真正引入了影响我游玩方式的东西。我理解Neo Scavenger也用文本屏幕来讲述剧情，但这款游戏的游玩方式不同。战斗不是通过文本屏幕进行的，探索不是通过文本屏幕进行的，对话不是通过文本屏幕进行的，它是在可暂停的实时中进行的。也许后面会发生什么，我读过一条开发者消息说确实会，但如果你在65.8小时后才只看到一次东西，那我敢说这里的内容不够多。

总之， blah blah 胡扯胡扯，游戏就是没完成。你仍然可以从中获得乐趣，但在决定是否购买之前应该考虑这一点。它从0.15（还是0.17？记不清了）版本脱离抢先体验，而且这很明显。

items.text:
Look, honestly, its one of those times I'd say a neutral review is in order, because the tension, the progression- from the very start to what I'd roughly consider 'midgame' (a very vague term because this game is exceptionally freeform, but for my example, roughly when you get your first crewmember) its great- theres quirks just about everywhere, things that seem important that aren't, things that are important but aren't made clear, etc- its great in the sense of exploration and giving you space to be player directed.

The problems come up when you get your ship larger- wanna do a complicated airlock that isn't your ship's docking port? You have literally only on and off switches to do that. They can be 'kinda' complicated and 'sorta' automated, but ultimately you'll be probably toggling two switches and its very... involved to operate it. And for some reason- at least in my game, the airlock ALWAYS leaked air despite the doors being closed. VERY frustrating- Only if the exterior door was unpowered did it not leak air.
You want your crew to consistently work during their working time? No dice, they'll more or less do whatever they want even with orders waiting- I didn't have this happen too often, and I'm willing to wave this off- if the game wants to simulate complex characters, then well- your workers might not work every hour of the day they're assigned, perfectly fine. I actually semi like this 'feature' if that is what it is.
You want your crewmember to actually use their freetime rather than sleeping during it? Well, thats another thing you can't really control. Also fine, but just a touch irritating- considering the idea is they'd fulfill their other needs during that freetime- their priorities seem always just a little wrong- he's tired, but he also needs to go take a dump- why not? oh, but he's also dirty, so he cleans himself first, then goes to sleep, and presumably he'll wake up to take a dump later, disrupting the actual sleep periods- which uhh, has gameplay detriments because they sleep LESS EFFECTIVELY during a non sleep shift!

Oh, and the fast forward option isn't really 'fast forwards' its more like 'skip these hours and depending on what actions are being done, increase attributes' which is SO very WRONG. Useful for training skills, TERRIBLE for actual gameplay- where you have to 'game' your fastfoward usage. I'd rather the game check all the facilities available on your ship and decrease requisite needs to zero when fast forwarding at this point. And time on the fastest -not fast forwards- speed is remarkably slow- you have 'a lot' of time. A lot of waiting. I didn't mind this, until I realized how incapable of the NPCS are to handling their own needs- even during freetime when they're suppose to. Yea, I'm not gonna lie, my initial plan to play this game was to make a long hauler to haul cargo between places and almost handle it like sims during the journey- a task thats implied to take in game days depending on where but I still haven't gotten there quite yet- but the need management is awful because it screws you on both fronts- either you play through the time legitimately and jump between your characters as you cycle through their needs- which wouldn't give much gameplay. Or you fastfowards and have to sorta do 'batches' of handling needs with the pure intent to just get there.

Then, finally, performance... The job assignment system is... Extremely inefficient. I don't have words to begin- if you order enough things to happen, your game will crawl as your crew and characters check 'every' single one of them for availability- now, this is partially because every freaking order is handled in like three parts- you order floor to be constructed. So what happens is they first check if it can be immediately done- makes sense... But typically, it cannot- it needs the floors delivered. Fine- you can either have loose floors from what you were salvaging or carried them with you (there are problems on this too- like certain items not stacking and or otherwise inefficencies that are painful regarding constructions.) Except for the fact that it first tries to do EVERY single floor job- which will lag your game as they replan to bring the floors to the job- and then they will bring floors ONE BY ONE (A item that stacks to five- oh and this also affects hauling floors) to each of the planned floors. So either you take direct control and tell them to pick up as many floors as they can, or you watch as you visibly age in the inky blackness of your unfinished construction slowly gets every floor delivered. Then it can start building. (EDIT:BTW planned walls block character movement as if they're actually there, and doors do it too, but only occasionally- pretty annoying.)

but wait, that needs battery power in your tools- and if you forget- then suddenly your guy is just twiddling his thumbs wasting time and leaving you confused- you learn to check their tools battery percentages pretty fast after noticing they're not working once you figure it out, but changing batteries is a three action interaction- you open the tool, you open the container with your batteries, you swap batteries. Furthermore, they can't tend to their own suit needs either- they won't even take off their helmet if they're in a safe environment to do so to conserve suit resources. I've seen NPCs suffocate ON STATIONS (extremely rare, they do usually take off their helmet once their suit is out of resources if they're in a safe zone, but still) because of this situation.

The situation is that all of these are individual situations that aren't 'too' big of a problem when individually confronted, but all of them at the same time? In a game asking you to operate a nuclear reactor? With the reward being 'the game will behave itself a little better' if you consistently solve each of these problems as they come up 'for' the game?

The game is excellent when you're a single guy on a scrapped together ship- clunky, but it feels a lot more meaningful when you're a solo guy whos doing literially everything you can to get out of a situation of being broke and effectively doing death runs to change your fate. Its once you start dreaming bigger, wanting to do more than cobble- wanting to make yourself a identity- is where the game starts fumbling.

Despite all of this, if there is one thing you can take away from my review- is that I have enjoyed my time with it despite my grouchiness with the systems. There is excellence here. But ultimately I think that until things are worked on even further than they have been- I would never think to recommend this to someone who asks for a space game- This has the bones to be one of the very best ones out there, it does so many things better than a innumerable number of other games- and if not better, at least individually worthwhile. This is a great game, but only worthwhile to those who have looked at it, and said 'This game is way too cool to pass up on' and is willing to bear with all of the difficulties with just playing the game that don't come from trying to survive in the game.
items.text_zh:
听着，老实说，这时候我会说给个中评是合适的，因为那种紧张感、那种推进——从最开始到我大致认为的“中期”（这个词很模糊，因为这游戏异常自由，但就我的例子而言，大约是你得到第一个船员的时候）它很棒——到处都有怪癖，看似重要其实不重要的事，重要但没被说清楚的事，等等——它在探索感和给你空间让玩家主导这方面很棒。

问题出现在你把船造得更大的时候——想做一个不是飞船对接舱口的复杂气闸？你实际上只有开和关的开关来做这件事。它们可以“有点”复杂，“算是”自动化，但最终你大概会拨动两个开关，操作起来非常……繁琐。而且不知为何——至少在我的游戏里，气闸即使门关着也总是漏气。非常令人沮丧——只有在外门没通电时才不漏气。
你想让你的船员在工作时间持续工作？没门，他们或多或少会为所欲为，即使有订单在等着——我遇到这种情况不太多，我也愿意对此睁一只眼闭一只眼——如果游戏想模拟复杂的角色，那么好吧——你的工人可能不会在分配给他们的每一天的每个小时都工作，完全没问题。如果这算是个“特性”，我其实半喜欢这个“特性”。
你想让你的船员在空闲时间真正利用空闲而不是睡觉？嗯，那是另一件你其实控制不了的事。也行，但就是有点恼人——考虑到本意是他们会在这段空闲时间里满足其他需求——他们的优先级似乎总是有点不对——他累了，但他也需要去拉屎——为什么不呢？哦，但他还脏，所以他先清洁自己，然后去睡觉，大概之后会醒来去拉屎，打乱实际的睡眠时段——呃，这有游戏玩法上的坏处，因为他们在非睡眠班次睡觉效率更低！

哦，还有快进选项并不是真的“快进”，它更像是“跳过这些小时，并根据正在进行的动作增加属性”，这实在太不对了。用来训练技能有用，对实际游玩很糟糕——你得“算计”着用快进。到这份上我宁愿游戏在快进时检查你船上所有可用设施，并把所需需求降到零。而最快——不是快进——速度下的时间慢得惊人——你有“很多”时间。很多等待。我本来不介意，直到我意识到NPC多么无能，连自己的需求都处理不好——即使在空闲时间，本该处理的时候。是的，不骗你，我最初玩这游戏的计划是造一艘长途货运船在各地之间运货，在旅途中几乎像模拟人生那样管理——这个任务暗示会根据地点花上游戏里的好几天，但我还没到那一步——但需求管理很糟糕，因为它在两方面都坑你——要么你老老实实玩过这段时间，在角色之间跳来跳去循环处理他们的需求——这不会带来多少玩法。要么你快进，然后不得不带着纯粹只想赶紧到那里的意图，像“批量”处理需求那样操作。

然后，最后，性能……工作分配系统……极其低效。我都不知道从何说起——如果你下令让足够多的事情发生，你的游戏会爬行，因为你的船员和角色会检查“每一个”任务的可用性——现在，这部分是因为每个该死的订单都分三部分处理——你下令建造地板。那么发生的是他们先检查能不能立刻做——合理……但通常不能——它需要地板被送达。行——你可以用打捞来的散装地板，或者随身带着（这方面也有问题——比如某些物品不能堆叠，以及其他在建造方面令人痛苦的效率低下。）除了这个事实：它会先尝试做每一个地板工作——这会让你的游戏卡顿，因为他们重新规划把地板送到工作地点——然后他们会把地板一个一个地送（一个能堆叠到五的物品——哦，这也影响搬运地板）到每个计划中的地板。所以要么你直接控制，告诉他们尽可能多拿地板，要么你看着自己在未完工建筑的漆黑中明显变老，地板慢慢被送达。然后它才能开始建造。（编辑：顺便说一句，计划中的墙会像实际存在一样阻挡角色移动，门也会，但只是偶尔——挺烦人的。）

但等等，那需要你工具里的电池电量——如果你忘了——那么突然你的家伙就只是闲着浪费时间，让你一头雾水——你很快学会检查他们工具的电池百分比，在注意到他们不工作并弄明白原因之后，但换电池是三个动作的交互——你打开工具，你打开装电池的容器，你换电池。此外，他们也不能照顾自己宇航服的需求——即使在安全环境里，他们也不会为了节省宇航服资源而摘下头盔。我见过NPC在空间站上窒息（极其罕见，他们通常会在宇航服资源耗尽后在安全区摘下头盔，但还是有）因为这种情况。

情况是，所有这些单独面对时都不是“太”大的问题，但全部同时出现呢？在一个要求你操作核反应堆的游戏里？而奖励是“如果你持续为游戏解决每一个出现的问题，游戏会表现得好一点”？

当你是一个人在一艘拼凑起来的船上时，这游戏非常出色——笨拙，但当你是一个独行侠，做着字面意义上一切能做的事来摆脱破产的处境，实际上进行死亡冲刺来改变命运时，感觉有意义得多。一旦你开始梦想更大，想做的不只是拼凑——想给自己一个身份——游戏就开始踉跄了。

尽管如此，如果你能从我的评测里带走一件事——那就是尽管我对这些系统满腹牢骚，我还是享受了和它相处的时间。这里有卓越之处。但最终我认为，除非事情比现在被进一步改进——我绝不会想到向一个要太空游戏的人推荐这个——它有成为市面上最优秀游戏之一的骨架，它在无数方面比数不清的其他游戏做得更好——如果不是更好，至少单独来看也值得。这是一款很棒的游戏，但只对那些看过它并说“这游戏太酷了不能错过”并愿意忍受所有仅仅是在玩这游戏（而非在游戏里求生）所带来的困难的人才值得。
足够多的事情要发生，你的游戏就会爬行，因为你的船员和角色会检查“每一个”事情的可用性——现在，这部分是因为每一个该死的命令都分三部分处理——你命令建造地板。所以发生的情况是，他们首先检查是否可以立即完成——这很合理……但通常，它不能——它需要地板被送达。好吧——你可以要么有从你打捞中得到的散装地板，要么随身携带它们（这方面也有问题——比如某些物品不能堆叠，或者在其他方面效率低下，这在建造方面很痛苦。）除了这样一个事实：它首先尝试做每一个地板工作——这会让你的游戏卡顿，因为他们重新计划把地板带到工作地点——然后他们会把地板一个一个地（一个能堆叠到五的物品——哦，这也影响搬运地板）带到每个计划的地板。所以要么你直接控制并告诉他们尽可能多地拿起地板，要么你看着自己在未完成建筑的漆黑中明显变老，慢慢地每一块地板都被送达。然后它才能开始建造。（编辑：顺便说一句，计划中的墙壁会像实际存在一样阻挡角色移动，门也会这样，但只是偶尔——相当烦人。）

但是等等，那需要你工具里的电池电量——如果你忘了——那么突然你的家伙就只是闲着浪费时间，让你困惑——一旦你弄明白他们不工作后，你会很快学会检查他们工具的电池百分比，但更换电池是一个三动作交互——你打开工具，你打开装电池的容器，你更换电池。此外，他们也不能照顾自己的宇航服需求——即使他们在安全环境中，他们也不会摘下头盔以节省宇航服资源。我见过NPC在空间站上窒息（极其罕见，他们通常会在宇航服资源耗尽后，如果在安全区域就摘下头盔，但仍然）因为这种情况。

情况是，所有这些都是个别情况，单独面对时并不是“太”大的问题，但所有这些问题同时出现呢？在一个要求你操作核反应堆的游戏中？而奖励是“游戏会表现得稍微好一点”，如果你持续地为游戏解决每一个出现的问题？

当你是一个人在一艘拼凑的飞船上时，游戏非常出色——笨拙，但当你是一个独行侠，做着你能做的一切来摆脱破产的处境，实际上进行死亡奔跑来改变你的命运时，它感觉更有意义。一旦你开始梦想更大，想要做更多而不只是拼凑——想要为自己建立一个身份——游戏就开始踉跄了。

尽管如此，如果你能从我的评论中带走一件事——那就是尽管我对这些系统有怨言，我还是享受了与它共度的时光。这里有卓越之处。但最终我认为，除非事情得到比现在更进一步的改进——我永远不会想到向一个要求太空游戏的人推荐这个——这个游戏有成为最优秀游戏之一的骨架，它在许多方面比无数其他游戏做得更好——如果不是更好，至少单独来看是值得的。这是一个伟大的游戏，但只对那些看过它并说“这个游戏太酷了，不能错过”的人值得，并且愿意忍受所有仅仅玩游戏带来的困难，而不是来自试图在游戏中生存的困难。
而且愿意忍受仅仅是在玩这个游戏时遇到的所有困难，这些困难并非来自试图在游戏中生存。

items.text:
(No spoilers ahead besides tutorial level)
[b] Summary REVIEW: [/b]
One of the best spacey simulator games I have ever played, but be warned this ain't some hyper star trek adventure, is painfully slow and methodical, you will suffer lots and every mistake is at best fatal and at worse an accidental war crime. 
No oxygen? Dead. Accelerated a little too fast for your squishy meat body? Dead. Your battery died? You are now a small meteor drifting into the cold space at 250m/s, and about to learn why they call Sir Isaac OG Newton the deadliest ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ in space. 

And if after all that you manage to scrap an ship and come home in a piece? You will find yourself surprised like I did, when I sold all for 14k sounds good? Well... -
3k for the fuel and O2/-5k for the  [i]temporary [/i] license to work and of course -2.5k you pay every 6 hours for the 2mil morgage on your ♥♥♥♥♥♥ ship oh and of course -3k to park your ship = 1.5k of profit 
Better start running bucko, because the bank wants their money on the next 5 hours and they will get it, out of your wallet or out of your body. So go back salvage actually worthy ♥♥♥♥, and live another day.

[b]Plot Review: [/b] As you may notice based on this, yes In this universe space was colonized by AmazonXspace inc (Trademark reserved). And in space there is no unproductive concept as weekends. So yes this game is basically just debt Simulator 2077 edition, and instead of the goverment you pay up the 5 mega-corps who run the solar system. 

And what about YOUR story? Simple, you are a [b]broke ass ♥♥♥♥♥[/b], but not an Venus beggar, no that would be too fancy for you, you are a belter, living in a lifeless rock that seems to supernaturally call derelict ships for some reason, and you  'brought' your own 'coffin', that being a small ship that will definitely and most likely kill you. But she is yours! (If you pay up the loan every day) And like an abusive relationship, someday you learn to love it in all it's errors

[b]Mechanics:[/b]
Days are divided in 4 cycles of 6 hours of your each, but worry not, amazon kindly provides you 22 exact minutes of rest between days. And when you are back you, your job is simple, gently, kindly, and very  [i]very[/i] slowly penetrate the derelict ship with your own, and proceed to SCRAP every worth part of that bad boy. But remember - not all garbage is created equal and you are on the clock. SO follow the rule of thumb (The DEVS actually patched in an little $$$ telling the price but still good to learn): The ship  is a dead body, and you are doing some organ haversting. meat and bones?(Hulls and cables) not worth your time. Lungs and kidneys? worth it, those include pumps and thrusters. But really the true bread and butter of the operation is the brain, by that I mean of course, The nuclear power reactor that powers every big ship. Easy to break, hard to find and incredibly radioactive, but oh so SOOO profitable. 

And that is just the beguinning, but I won't ruin the whole fun, that should give you just enough to not get your legs broken by the mob, but you will still die horribly and frequently, until you learn deep in your soul why every part of your ship, has it's unique and detailed MANUAL OF INSTRUCTIONS with an portion dedicated to what [b]NOT TO DO[/b]. And no, your little tiktok fried mush brain, won't know how to turn on the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ reactor, swallow your pride and go watch the tutorial. Or suffer the Chernobyl experience. 

On a final note, the game will soon receive it's 1.0, but it still on early acess now, and it has many small annoying bugs, and the performance will choke and die if you trying building your cargo ship all at once. It is an pretty ambicious game made by a pretty small dedicated team. And in a world where Star Citizen can receive 1 billion and release absolute ♥♥♥♥ with micro-transaction ships... Yeah I rather ride my Coffin any day. So support your indies and pay a few bucks for something with soul.
items.text_zh:
（除教程关卡外无剧透）
[b] 总结评测：[/b]
这是我玩过的最好的太空模拟游戏之一，但请注意，这可不是什么超光速《星际迷航》式的冒险，它慢得令人痛苦且极其讲究方法，你会受苦，而且每一个错误往好了说是致命的，往坏了说就是一场意外的战争罪行。
没氧气？死。为你的软肉之躯加速稍微快了一点？死。你的电池没电了？你现在就是一颗以250米/秒漂向寒冷太空的小流星，并且即将明白为什么他们称艾萨克·OG·牛顿爵士是太空中最致命的♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥。

而如果经历了这一切之后，你成功拆了一艘船并完整地回了家呢？你会像我一样惊讶地发现，当我把所有东西卖了14k听起来不错？嗯…… -
3k的燃料和氧气/-5k的[i]临时[/i]工作执照，当然还有你每6小时为你那艘♥♥♥♥♥♥飞船的2百万抵押贷款支付的-2.5k，哦当然还有-3k的停船费 = 1.5k的利润
最好开始跑起来吧，小子，因为银行在接下来的5小时内就要他们的钱，而且他们一定会拿到，要么从你的钱包里，要么从你的身体里。所以回去打捞真正有价值的♥♥♥♥，然后多活一天。

[b]剧情评测：[/b] 正如你可能从中注意到的，是的，在这个宇宙中，太空是由AmazonXspace公司（商标保留）殖民的。而且在太空中，不存在周末这种没有生产力的概念。所以是的，这款游戏基本上就是《债务模拟器2077》版，而且你不是向政府交钱，而是向统治太阳系的5家巨型企业交钱。

那你自己的故事呢？很简单，你是一个[b]穷得叮当响的♥♥♥♥♥[/b]，但不是金星乞丐，不，那对你来说太花哨了，你是一个带带人，住在一块毫无生气的岩石上，它似乎出于某种原因超自然地吸引废弃飞船，而你“带来”了你自己的“棺材”，也就是一艘肯定会、而且极有可能杀死你的小船。但她是你的！（如果你每天都还清贷款的话）而且就像一段虐待关系一样，总有一天你会学会爱它的所有缺陷

[b]机制：[/b]
每天被分为4个周期，每个周期6小时，但别担心，亚马逊好心地在你每天之间提供整整22分钟的休息时间。而当你回来时，你的工作很简单，温柔地、友善地、并且非常[i]非常[/i]缓慢地用你自己的船插入那艘废弃飞船，然后开始拆解那家伙身上每一个值钱的部件。但记住——不是所有垃圾都生来平等，而且你是在计时工作。所以遵循经验法则（开发者实际上已经打上了一个小小的$$$来显示价格，但仍然值得学习）：飞船是一具尸体，而你在做器官摘取。肉和骨头？（船体和电缆）不值得你花时间。肺和肾？值得，那些包括泵和推进器。但真正让这门生意赖以生存的黄油面包，是大脑，当然，我指的是为每艘大船提供动力的核反应堆。容易损坏，难以找到，而且放射性极强，但哦，如此如此如此有利可图。

而这只是开始，但我不会破坏全部乐趣，这应该足够让你不至于被黑帮打断腿，但你仍然会可怕而频繁地死去，直到你在灵魂深处明白为什么你飞船的每一个部件都有它独特而详细的说明书，其中还有一部分专门讲[b]不要做什么[/b]。不，你那被TikTok炸成糊状的小脑子，不会知道怎么打开那♥♥♥♥♥♥♥反应堆，收起你的骄傲，去看教程。否则就体验切尔诺贝利吧。

最后一点，这款游戏很快就会迎来它的1.0版本，但现在仍处于抢先体验阶段，它有许多小而烦人的bug，而且如果你试图一次性建造你的货船，性能会窒息而死。这是一款由一支相当小而专注的团队制作的相当有野心的游戏。而在这个《星际公民》能拿到10亿美元却发布绝对♥♥♥♥还带微交易飞船的世界里……是的，我宁愿每天都骑我的棺材。所以支持你的独立游戏，为有灵魂的东西花几块钱吧。

items.text:
A procedural game that feels like the minimum "feature complete" framework for a game, and a massive timesink. Hard to recommend, unless you're looking for House Flipper in space, but even House Flipper has more engaging fixer-upper gameplay.

Like Shadows of Doubt or Kenshi, there's a barebones gameplay loop here (fly ship to derelict, check for useful stuff, take it back to sell or bolt it on your ship) and you're left to imagine the interesting parts.

Repairs and disassembly are just "click repair/disassemble button and wait". There's not a minigame or anything. You click, then watch your guy do it for a couple seconds or minutes. If you have the tools, your guy will automatically use them, but you're not turning bolts, or even following a disassembly procedure like in Space Station 13, so it's hard to call it engaging. Especially as, once you get the EVA suit, you can basically ignore power or oxygen.

The docking procedure is probably the most entertaining part of the core loop, but it's just "line up two rings and don't crash". This does get spicier when the game hits an update tick and locks up for a minute straight, which is frequent.

Derelicts don't have too much variety, and the pool of potential parts is nothing expansive. You can spend hours building out rooms tile-by-tile if you're OCD or very bored and want to play Extreme Ship Makeover, but there's fewer functional parts than any car modding game. Don't expect tuning, or a variety of engines or thruster models or anything.

There's a hacking skill, but it only works on PDAs, and PDAs have almost nothing but pages of nonfunctional lore on them. Well-written lore it is, but you won't be hacking terminals, or doors, or turrets, or anything interesting. Par for the course, there's nothing more to this system than clicking "hack" and it happens.

Overall, the world of the game - there's not much gameplay depth to it, outside the atmospheric and needs simulation. NPCs have only procedural dialogue to spout, their requests have no meaningful rewards or intrigue, and any handcrafted stations make the game chug, despite having little to do or interact with.

But you can read pages of lore about what you can imagine you'd see and experience if this was a fuller game. There's a seed of potential in it all, but with 1.0 coming up, it looks like this is as far as it'll go. Even if the bugs and performance get ironed out, it's hard to recommend.
items.text_zh:
一款程序化生成的游戏，感觉就像一款游戏最低限度的“功能完整”框架，而且极其耗时。很难推荐，除非你在寻找太空版《房产达人》，但即便是《房产达人》也有更引人入胜的翻新玩法。

就像《疑影重重》或《剑士》一样，这里有一个极简的游戏循环（驾驶飞船前往废弃船只，检查有用的东西，带回去卖掉或装到你的船上），剩下的有趣部分全靠你自己想象。

修理和拆解就只是“点击修理/拆解按钮然后等待”。没有什么小游戏之类的。你点击，然后看着你的角色做上几秒或几分钟。如果你有工具，你的角色会自动使用它们，但你并不是在拧螺栓，甚至也不是像《太空站13》那样遵循拆解流程，所以很难说它引人入胜。尤其是，一旦你拿到EVA宇航服，你基本上可以无视电力和氧气。

对接程序大概是核心循环中最有趣的部分，但它也只是“对齐两个环并且别撞上”。当游戏碰到更新周期卡死整整一分钟时，这确实会变得更刺激，而这种情况很频繁。

废弃船只没有太多变化，潜在零件的池子也毫无扩展性。如果你是强迫症或者非常无聊、想玩“极限飞船大改造”，你可以花几个小时一块一块地搭建房间，但可用的功能部件比任何汽车改装游戏都少。别指望调校，也别指望有各种引擎或推进器型号之类的。

有一个黑客技能，但它只对PDA有效，而PDA上几乎只有一页页无功能的背景设定。写得倒是不错的背景设定，但你不会去黑终端、门、炮塔或任何有趣的东西。意料之中，这个系统除了点击“黑入”然后它就发生了之外，没有更多内容。

总体而言，这款游戏的世界——除了氛围和需求模拟之外，并没有多少玩法深度。NPC只有程序化生成的对话可说，他们的请求没有有意义的奖励或悬念，而任何手工制作的太空站都会让游戏卡顿，尽管那里几乎没什么可做或可互动的。

但你可以阅读一页页的背景设定，想象如果这是一款更完整的游戏，你可能会看到和体验到什么。这一切中有一颗潜力的种子，但随着1.0即将到来，看起来它也就只能走到这一步了。即使bug和性能问题被解决，也很难推荐。
